text: DESCRIPTION OF FACILITIES -------------------------
target: DESCRIPTION OF FACILITIES -------------------------

text: The Dominion Terminal Associates coal facility is sized to have an annual throughput of approximately 20 million tons per year .
target: <entity type="organization">The Dominion Terminal Associates</entity> coal facility is sized to have an annual throughput of approximately 20 million tons per year .

text: A total ground storage capacity of approximately 1 . 5 million tons is available .
target: A total ground storage capacity of approximately 1 . 5 million tons is available .

text: The terminal pier and loading facilities are designed to handle colliers ranging in size from 20 , 000 to 173 , 000 dwt .
target: The terminal pier and loading facilities are designed to handle colliers ranging in size from 20 , 000 to 173 , 000 dwt .

text: and barges of varying sizes .
target: and barges of varying sizes .

text: The land on which the facility is located is on the east bank of the James River in Newport News , Virginia .
target: The land on which the facility is located is on the <entity type="location">east</entity> bank of the James River in Newport News , <entity type="location">Virginia</entity> .
entities: east bank of the James River in Newport News

text: It is bordered on the northwest by the Pier IX coal terminal and on the southeast by the CSX Piers 14 and 15 properties which are now limited in use , the primary business of Piers 14 and 15 appearing to be the leasing of the piers .
target: It is bordered on the <entity type="location">northwest</entity> by the <entity type="location">Pier IX coal terminal</entity> and on the <entity type="location">southeast</entity> by the <entity type="location">CSX Piers 14 and 15</entity> properties which are now limited in use , the primary business of <entity type="location">Piers 14 and 15</entity> appearing to be the leasing of the piers .

text: The deep water channel , approximately 50 feet deep , borders the site .
target: The deep water channel , approximately 50 feet deep , borders the site .

text: Road access to the facility is from Harbor Road , which borders the south side of the terminal site .
target: Road access to the facility is from <entity type="location">Harbor Road</entity> , which borders the <entity type="location">south</entity> side of the terminal site .

text: Railroad Service .
target: Railroad Service .

text: The coal terminal facility is served by CSX Transportation , Inc . CSX brings loaded cars to the empty tracks .
target: The coal terminal facility is served by <entity type="organization">CSX Transportation</entity> , Inc . <entity type="organization">CSX</entity> brings loaded cars to the empty tracks .

text: DTA moves the loaded cars from the empty tracks into position for dumping and then moves the cars back to the empty tracks .
target: DTA moves the loaded cars from the empty tracks into position for dumping and then moves the cars back to the empty tracks .

text: Material Handling System .
target: Material Handling System .

text: The material handling system is designed so that coal may be unloaded from the railroad hopper cars and transported by conveyor directly to the shiploader for depositing in the holds of vessels .
target: The material handling system is designed so that coal may be unloaded from the railroad hopper cars and transported by conveyor directly to the shiploader for depositing in the holds of vessels .

text: However , most of the coal received is transported to one or two stacker / reclaimers for deposit on the ground storage piles .
target: However , most of the coal received is transported to one or two stacker / reclaimers for deposit on the ground storage piles .

text: An enclosed tandem rotary car dumper is used to unload the hopper cars two at a time .
target: An enclosed tandem rotary car dumper is used to unload the hopper cars two at a time .

text: The coal deposited in the hoppers beneath the dumper passes through a grizzly which prevents large foreign material from entering and damaging the belt conveying system .
target: The coal deposited in the hoppers beneath the dumper passes through a grizzly which prevents large foreign material from entering and damaging the belt conveying system .

text: Just prior to dumping , the rail cars pass through a thaw shed which assists in unloading during freezing weather .
target: Just prior to dumping , the rail cars pass through a thaw shed which assists in unloading during freezing weather .

text: Vibrating feeders transfer the coal from the receiving hoppers to the conveyor belts and place it on conveyor belts for elevation up above grade to a 1 , 000 - ton surge silo .
target: Vibrating feeders transfer the coal from the receiving hoppers to the conveyor belts and place it on conveyor belts for elevation up above grade to a 1 , 000 - ton surge silo .

text: The surge silo is used to increase unloading efficiency by allowing the coal to accumulate while the stacker / reclaimer is moving from one stockpile to another .
target: The surge silo is used to increase unloading efficiency by allowing the coal to accumulate while the stacker / reclaimer is moving from one stockpile to another .

text: A three - stage " as received " sampling system is provided at the 1 , 000 - ton storage silo .
target: A three - stage " as received " sampling system is provided at the 1 , 000 - ton storage silo .

text: While the unloading system is in operation , coal received may be diverted directly to waiting colliers or barges or transferred to either of two stacker / reclaimers for stacking in stockpiles .
target: While the unloading system is in operation , coal received may be diverted directly to waiting colliers or barges or transferred to either of two stacker / reclaimers for stacking in stockpiles .

text: The design rate for the receiving material handling system is 5 , 200 tons / hr .
target: The design rate for the receiving material handling system is 5 , 200 tons / hr .

text: < PAGE >
target: < PAGE >

text: The reclaim system provides for reclaiming coal with either or both stacker / reclaimers and a reclaimer , then conveying it to two - 4 , 000 ton surge silos located near the pier .
target: The reclaim system provides for reclaiming coal with either or both stacker / reclaimers and a reclaimer , then conveying it to two - 4 , 000 ton surge silos located near the pier .

text: Reclaim from these surge silos goes directly to the pier - mounted shiploader for loading into the holds of coal carriers .
target: Reclaim from these surge silos goes directly to the pier - mounted shiploader for loading into the holds of coal carriers .

text: When blending two different types of coal is required , the proper percentage of each is withdrawn from each silo .
target: When blending two different types of coal is required , the proper percentage of each is withdrawn from each silo .

text: An " As Shipped " sampling system is located at the tail end of the conveyor leading to the shiploader .
target: An " As Shipped " sampling system is located at the tail end of the conveyor leading to the shiploader .

text: Belt scales are provided for both the unloading system and the shiploading system to provide the necessary information for managing the coal stockpiles , blending and as a check against the draft surveyor ' s measurement for the coal being loaded in vessels .
target: Belt scales are provided for both the unloading system and the shiploading system to provide the necessary information for managing the coal stockpiles , blending and as a check against the draft surveyor ' s measurement for the coal being loaded in vessels .

text: The design rate for the reclaim handling system is 6 , 800 tons / hr .
target: The design rate for the reclaim handling system is 6 , 800 tons / hr .

text: The shiploader and dock conveyor is rated at 6 , 500 tons / hr .
target: The shiploader and dock conveyor is rated at 6 , 500 tons / hr .

text: The higher capacity takes into account shiploader shutdowns for hatch changes .
target: The higher capacity takes into account shiploader shutdowns for hatch changes .

text: Marine Facilities .
target: Marine Facilities .

text: The marine facilities include a dredge deep - water basin and shiploader pier .
target: The marine facilities include a dredge deep - water basin and shiploader pier .

text: The dredging provides access and berthing areas at the pier which extends towards shore from the Corps of Engineers ' pierhead line .
target: The dredging provides access and berthing areas at the pier which extends towards shore from the <entity type="organization">Corps of Engineers</entity> ' pierhead line .

text: An area on the south side of the pier has been dredged to a depth of 50 feet to match the existing channel .
target: An area on the south side of the pier has been dredged to a depth of 50 feet to match the existing channel .

text: The north side of the pier can be dredged to a depth of 50 feet if so necessitated by an increase in business .
target: The north side of the pier can be dredged to a depth of 50 feet if so necessitated by an increase in business .

text: The shiploader dock is designed as a finger pier with a berth on each side for loading colliers up to 173 , 000 dwt .
target: The shiploader dock is designed as a finger pier with a berth on each side for loading colliers up to 173 , 000 dwt .

text: It is provided with a trestle connection to shore .
target: It is provided with a trestle connection to shore .

text: The pier supports the shiploading conveyor and shiploader , plus a roadway with a turnaround area at the offshore end .
target: The pier supports the shiploading conveyor and shiploader , plus a roadway with a turnaround area at the offshore end .

text: Both faces of the pier are provided with a fendering system .
target: Both faces of the pier are provided with a fendering system .

text: A turning dolphin has been constructed at the outer end , connected by a walkway to the pier .
target: A turning dolphin has been constructed at the outer end , connected by a walkway to the pier .

target: Mobile Equipment .

text: Mobile equipment is used for maintenance and operation of the coal terminal facility .
target: Mobile equipment is used for maintenance and operation of the coal terminal facility .

text: Switch engines are used to move trains while dozers are needed to assist the bucket wheel stackers and reclaimers in storing and reclaiming coal outside their reach .
target: Switch engines are used to move trains while dozers are needed to assist the bucket wheel stackers and reclaimers in storing and reclaiming coal outside their reach .

text: The following types of mobile equipment are provided for the facility :
target: The following types of mobile equipment are provided for the facility :

target: a . Track - mounted dozers with coal blades ;

text: b .
target: b .

target: Switch Engines ;

target: c . Mobile cranes ;

text: d . Flat - bed trucks ;
target: d . Flat - bed trucks ;

text: e . Pickup trucks ;
target: e . Pickup trucks ;

text: f . Automobiles ;

target: h . Front - end loader .

target: The rotary dumper and the receiving hopper vibrating feeders have a separate control panel located in the dumper building .
